info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Update API enables authorized users to modify the details of specific external agencies identified by a unique parameter. This API facilitates efficient management of correspondent bank relationships, allowing businesses to keep essential information up-to-date. Typical users include bank administrators and financial institutions that rely on accurate agency data for compliance and operational purposes. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can ensure that their applications reflect the latest agency information, enhancing connectivity and service reliability.

patch.description: This API endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific correspondent bank relationship by its unique identifier. You can modify various attributes associated with the relationship to ensure accurate and up-to-date information.

requestBody.description: Updates the correspondent bank relationship for the specified agency. This operation allows for modifying attributes related to the bank relationship.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
